name: Spartan Auto & Heavy Truck Parts
old_description: At Spartan Auto parts, we understand the passion behind every restoration project. Our extensive inventory ensures you have access to the highest quality parts to breathe new life into your vehicle. Whether you're tackling a full restoration or just making essential repairs, our knowledgeable team is here to guide you every step of the way. Let us help you restore your ride to its former glory!
about:
Spartan Auto & Heavy Truck Parts operates from Inman, South Carolina, where it has served the automotive and heavy-truck aftermarket for over two decades. The company traces its roots to a focus on restoration-grade components, though no founding year or original owners are publicly disclosed.

The business stocks more than 100,000 individual part numbers covering automobiles and heavy trucks, ranging from OEM replacements to used components. Inventory is managed through an online catalog and an eBay storefront, with fulfillment handled from the Inman facility. No manufacturing or machining processes are performed on-site.

Customers include restoration enthusiasts, independent repair shops, and fleet operators seeking maintenance, repair, or project parts for both light-duty and heavy-duty vehicles. The company cites a base of 30,000-plus satisfied customers and a 95 percent satisfaction rate, though specific client names are not provided.

Spartan differentiates itself with a price-match guarantee, negotiable pricing, and a commitment to ship orders to the lower 48 states within one to five days. The emphasis on OEM-quality used parts and responsive customer service reflects its stated mission to simplify the parts-sourcing process for vehicle owners and professionals alike.
